provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: Assumes the generator's domain. Shapes are separated by at least one blank line, so 8-connected components never merge. Background is palette[0], and shape colours differ from the background. The demonstrations are not consulted because the mechanism is fully determined by d4. The clamp never triggers for valid shapes, since non-wall cells are strictly before the wall; it is kept for fidelity to the archived solver. The fixtures are consistent with the uniform rule. This factory has not been executed or tested.
